module: Powertrain component `shaft`: a drive shaft with a fixed reduction ratio, friction losses and cumulative inertia. It can also be linked directly to a wheel (jbeam key `connectedWheel`), in which case it applies the propulsion torque and the friction torque to the wheel. It can be disconnected (mode `disconnected`) or broken; it then accelerates a virtual mass instead of the downstream drivetrain. A modder uses it via the `powertrain` jbeam; the module only exposes `new`.
usage:
-- jbeam: ["wheelShaftFL", "shaft", "differential_F", 1, {"connectedWheel":"FL", "friction":0.5}]
local d = powertrain.getDevice("wheelShaftFL")
d:setMode("disconnected") -- only if canDisconnect=true in the jbeam
notes: Jbeam keys read: name, type, inputName, inputIndex, gearRatio (default 1), friction (N·m, default 0), dynamicFriction (N·m per rad/s, default 0), torqueLossCoef (fraction of the input torque lost, default 0), electricsName, visualShaftAVName, node, connectedWheel (wheel name from powertrain.wheels), outputPortOverride (list of output port indices), canDisconnect, isDisconnected, breakTriggerBeam (empty string = cancels the beam).

Main fields of the device: inputAV (rad/s, parent side speed = output * gearRatio), outputAV1 (rad/s, or outputAV<N> if outputPortOverride; child or wheel side speed), outputTorque1 (N·m, same), gearRatio, friction, dynamicFriction, torqueLossCoef, cumulativeInertia (kg·m² reflected to the input side), invCumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio, maxCumulativeGearRatio, virtualInertia (default 2 kg·m², used if nothing is connected), virtualMassAV (rad/s), isBroken, mode, availableModes, defaultMode, wearFrictionCoef, damageFrictionCoef.

The names outputAV1/outputTorque1 are actually computed: device.outputAVName / device.outputTorqueName are 'outputAV'..N and 'outputTorque'..N with N = last index of outputPortOverride (1 by default). Same for parentOutputAVName / parentOutputTorqueName, set by the powertrain.

velocityUpdate and torqueUpdate are reassigned by selectUpdates depending on the state: normal, linked to a wheel, disconnected/broken, or disconnected wheel. Do not call them assuming a fixed version.
Disconnected or broken: outputTorque is set to 0 and a virtual torque accelerates virtualMassAV with invCumulativeInertia; for a wheel, propulsionTorque is 0 and frictionTorque is friction.
Connected mode with wheel: the reaction torque is accumulated in powertrain.torqueReactionCoefs[wheel.torsionReactorIdx] as an absolute value.

isPhysicallyDisconnected is true by default in new; it is set back to the real value by the powertrain. As long as it is true, validate forces the 'disconnected' mode and setMode refuses any other mode.
Wear: wearFrictionCoef = linearScale(odometer, 3e7, 1e9, 1, 1.5). Damage: damageFrictionCoef goes from 1 to 50 when the integrity drops from 1 to 0.

The exported fields M.outputPorts = {[1]=true} and M.deviceCategories = {shaft=true} are copied into each device. new also reads M.requiredExternalInertiaOutputs, which is never defined in this file (shallowcopy of nil).

outputPorts.desc: Default output ports: {[1]=true}. Copied into each device (replaced if outputPortOverride).

deviceCategories.desc: Categories of the component: {shaft=true}. Used by searches such as 'walk up to the parent differential'.

new.desc: Builds a shaft device from a jbeam entry. Reads gearRatio, frictions, connectedWheel, outputPortOverride, canDisconnect and breakTriggerBeam, chooses the output field names and selects the update functions.

jbeamData.desc: jbeam data of the component (name, type, gearRatio, friction, connectedWheel…).

device.desc: Object returned by new(jbeamData). The methods are set on the instance; velocityUpdate/torqueUpdate are assigned dynamically.

velocityUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step, from downstream to upstream. Computes inputAV = outputAV * gearRatio and writes it into the parent's speed field. Wheel version: reads wheel.angularVelocity * wheelDirection. Disconnected version: uses virtualMassAV instead.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds (unused except by convention).

torqueUpdate.desc: Called at each physics step, from upstream to downstream. Computes the output torque = (parent torque - friction losses) * gearRatio; for a wheel, writes propulsionTorque and frictionTorque. Disconnected version: accelerates the virtual mass and sets outputTorque to 0.

dt.desc: Time step in seconds (used by the disconnected versions).

applyDeformGroupDamage.desc: Increases damageFrictionCoef proportionally to the damage received (0.01 of damage = +0.1).

damageAmount.desc: Amount of damage of the deformation group.

setPartCondition.desc: Applies the wear/damage state of a part: wearFrictionCoef according to the odometer, damageFrictionCoef according to the integrity. If the integrity is a table with isBroken, calls onBreak.

odometer.desc: Distance traveled in meters (scale 30000 km to 1000000 km for a wear coefficient of 1 to 1.5).

getPartCondition.desc: Returns the state of the part for saving: integrity 0..1 (0 if broken) and table {damageFrictionCoef, isBroken}.

validate.desc: Called by the powertrain after construction. Forces disconnected mode if isPhysicallyDisconnected. For a shaft with no child or wheel, takes the default virtualInertia of the ancestor differential. For a wheel shaft, finds the ancestor torsionReactor and declares its reaction nodes to the wheel (setEngineAxisCoupleNodes).

updateSimpleControlButtons.desc: If the shaft has several modes and uiSimpleModeControl, updates the simple UI button (extensions.ui_simplePowertrainControl.setButton) that calls powertrain.toggleDeviceMode(name).

setMode.desc: Changes the mode ('connected' or 'disconnected') if it is in availableModes. Ignored otherwise. A physically disconnected shaft stays 'disconnected'. Reselects the update functions and updates the UI button.

getState.desc: Defined only if the shaft has several modes. Returns the stateData table containing the key '<name>Mode' = current mode.

setState.desc: Defined only if the shaft has several modes. Restores the mode from data['<name>Mode'] if it is a string different from the current mode.

onBreak.desc: Marks the shaft as broken (isBroken = true) and switches to the disconnected update functions. Called by the broken beams system / setPartCondition.

calculateInertia.desc: Computes cumulativeInertia, invCumulativeInertia, cumulativeGearRatio and maxCumulativeGearRatio. Takes the inertia of the first child, or the inertia of the wheel nodes around the axis (sum of mass * distance²), or virtualInertia. Divided by gearRatio². Called by the powertrain during init.

reset.desc: Resets the dynamic state (inputAV, virtualMassAV, wear coefficients, isBroken, outputs to 0) and rereads gearRatio and friction from jbeamData. Called on vehicle reset.
